summary: PLDT Inc., a Philippine foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K reporting routine matters: unaudited interim financial results for H1 2026, declaration of regular cash dividends on common and preferred stock, and promotions of officers. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, spin-off, restructuring, or other special-situation event is disclosed. The filing is a standard current report under Rule 13a-16, with no board recommendation, advisor, premium, or deal terms. What to watch: none; this is ordinary operational and dividend disclosure.
